objective: Size the phone shell's scroll-padding-bottom from the bottom bar it clears: calc(var(--target-min) + 1px + var(--space-2) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), the bar's own row and edge plus the same space-2 allowance scroll-padding-top gives the header, instead of the space-8 + space-2 sized for the two-line bar FRONTEND-035 removed; pinned by the bar's geometry so the two cannot drift apart.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: agent/FRONTEND-057 is cut from the tip of the integration branch outstanding-track-5 after FRONTEND-056 merged. The two units write no path in common.

The geometry, from the CSS at 3084e22 (the Director's; brief.md has the history): the bar is one row of .link cells, min-height var(--target-min) (2.75rem, 44 px; the 24 px icon plus 2 x space-2 padding is 40 px, under it), plus .nav's 1 px border-top edge, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom): 45 px and the safe area. A focused control's ring is base.css's :focus-visible outline, 2 px wide at a 2 px offset: it reaches 4 px past the control's box. So the least that clears the bar is 49 px and the safe area. Today's value is var(--space-8) + var(--space-2), 72 px and the safe area: sized when the bar's labels could wrap to two lines (FRONTEND-027 measured a 69.8 px bar, so 72 px left a ring about 3 to 5 px short: the backlog's "about 5 px short"); FRONTEND-035 made the bar icons only and kept the number, so today it is 23 px more than the bar needs. The corrected value is the bar plus var(--space-2): 53 px and the safe area, leaving 4 px between the ring and the bar's top edge, as scroll-padding-top (var(--target-min) + 3 * var(--space-2)) leaves over the 60 px header.

Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation. The red reason is that :global(html)'s scroll-padding-bottom is still calc(var(--space-8) + var(--space-2) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), 72 px, not the bar's 45 px plus space-2.

frontend/src/routes/shell-css.test.ts, describe "the bottom bar and the header's room": the existing test "sizes scroll-padding-bottom for the bar's two-line height, and 0 from 40em" changes, because it pins the old string and the bar has had no second line since FRONTEND-035. It becomes "sizes scroll-padding-bottom from the bar's tokens plus space-2, and 0 from 40em" and expects, whitespace out, calc(var(--target-min)+1px+var(--space-2)+env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); its 0 from 40em half is unchanged. One test is added beside it, "clears the bar and the focus ring, by no more than space-2": with lengthInRem and shorthandParts (test/compose-modal, as floating-clearance.test.ts uses them; env() taken as 0) it reads the bar as the top-level .link rule's min-height plus the first part of the top-level .nav rule's border-top, the ring as the first part of styles/base.css's top-level :focus-visible outline plus its outline-offset, and scroll-padding-bottom from the top-level :global(html) rule, and asserts bar + ring <= scroll-padding-bottom <= bar + var(--space-2) (resolved). Today it reads 44 + 1 and 2 + 2 against 72 px and is red on the upper bound; after, 53 px is inside both. The test "does not call the bar under space-8 tall in the comment at the top" and every other test stay as they are.

AppLayout.module.css: the top-level :global(html) rule's scroll-padding-bottom is calc(var(--target-min) + 1px + var(--space-2) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), as Prettier formats it; scroll-padding-top and the 40em rule's scroll-padding-bottom: 0 are unchanged. The file's top comment replaces "about 45 px, which scroll-padding-bottom (space-8 + space-2, 72 px) clears" with the derivation: the bar is target-min plus its 1 px edge and the safe area, and scroll-padding-bottom is that plus space-2, room for the 4 px focus ring, as scroll-padding-top is the header plus space-2 (FRONTEND-057). Nothing else in the file changes: main's bottom padding, the bar, the + offsets and FloatingButton.module.css are not this unit's.
Existing tests other than the one named stay untouched and green, including floating-clearance.test.ts, sidebar-nav.test.tsx and AppLayout.test.tsx.

Bundle: no bundle-budgets file. The Director's prototype of this value (measured together with FRONTEND-056's HomeView change against BASE refolded at 3084e22) moved the entry CSS +7 B gzip and the entry JS not at all; every lazy output moved by 3 B or less. Proof: npm run lint reports 0 problems; npm run typecheck and npm run build are green; the suite runs in the foreground, alone, sharded (npx vitest run --shard=N/3 --maxWorkers=2), and the PR records the shard counts and the measured bundle numbers.
No new dependency; no change outside the allowed paths.

Module docs: wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08k-frontend-account.md's "The shell's shape" bullet (the shell's record; 0x08a has no scroll-padding line) replaces "`scroll-padding-bottom` stays `--space-8` + `--space-2` on phones" with: on phones scroll-padding-bottom is the bar (`--target-min` plus its 1 px edge and the safe area) plus `--space-2`, 53 px, which clears the 4 px focus ring (FRONTEND-057).
